basis: Aug/NGQ26 clean; data year ends ~07-20 so this is the last fully-staged block

last_hour.direction_caveat: the last-hour NET is 1 tick(s), 11% of the $90 last-hour range - at or near the price resolution floor, so anchor_lasthr_dir is a WEAK signal and should not be leaned on as a seam direction. close_in_range (0.222) is derived from the same data and is the sturdier read.
last_hour.provenance: price levels derived from the actual file's DOWNSAMPLED `continuous` render path, not the raw tape. Trade count and signed flow are NOT recoverable from a downsampled series and are null by design - a number computed off this series would be wrong-but-well-formed.

session_activity.source: tape_conditions.prior_full_session (scored leg); NOTE session_b_share is a declared RECONSTRUCTION, not a direct measurement - see session_b_share_basis
session_activity.session_b_share_basis: RECONSTRUCTED S109 from session_b_share_two_sided x (1 - unsided_volume_frac), an exact identity, because the S108 leg reader's side encoding zeroed the direct computation. Carries up to ~0.002 of rounding error vs a re-stage off raw lots; a re-stage overwrites it.

holiday_caveat: 20260703 is a HOLIDAY half-session (11501 trades against a ~37,000 normal-session median). The anchor CLOSE is chain-verified and sound. The anchor's LAST-HOUR DIRECTION is derived from this thin tape, so it is a weaker seam signal than the same field in G17-G21 - size the weekend/reopen read accordingly and do not treat it as a full-session exit. Declared, not hidden.
